name: Emotional Infidelity
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a serious sin, emphasizing not only the physical act but also the intentions of the heart. Exodus 20:14 and Deuteronomy 22:22 establish the gravity of marital unfaithfulness, while Proverbs 6:32 highlights the destruction it brings to the soul. Jesus deepens this understanding in Matthew 5:27-28 by teaching that even lustful thoughts constitute adultery in the heart, revealing that emotional infidelity is a violation of God’s standard for purity and faithfulness. God's desire, as expressed in Jeremiah 29:11, is for His people to live in peace and integrity, reflecting His good plans for their lives.
